Input image 2 is the project-original Persian uniform reference. Change ONLY the two riders' uniform identity in all four headings: the front mahout wears a fitted deep turquoise/azure Persian tunic with embroidered gold collar, cuffs, belt and hem, cream trousers and brown leather boots; replace his white turban/red skullcap with the same blue flat fluted Persian cap with gold vertical edging visible on the infantry reference. He remains a practical unarmored driver holding the same short guiding tool and reins. The rear howdah spearman wears the same turquoise blue sleeves and gold scale cuirass, neckcloth and gold-trimmed cap/helmet of the Persian soldiers in reference 2, not generic dark gray armor. Both men should clearly belong to the same Persian faction as reference 2. Preserve exactly the four complete elephants, direction ordering SE, SW, NE rear, NW rear, anatomy, gray skin, cobalt blue gold floral caparison, wooden howdah, weapon lengths, walking leg contacts, isometric camera, upper-left lighting, source positions and spacious transparent gutters. No cropping, no detached limbs, no extra units, no flags or floor, no text or watermark. Fine realistic painted details, not plastic or chibi. Wide one-row four-column atlas, high native resolution matching source shape. Keep the entire actor including spear tips and tusks inside each cell. Genuine transparent background.
